_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Devarim 11, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: So love God your Lord, and keep what He has entrusted you to keep — His statutes, His commandments, and His ordinances — all the time.
translations.2: And know from this day that the obligation does not fall upon your children, who have not known and have not seen the discipline of God your Lord, and His greatness, and His mighty hand, and His outstretched arm —
translations.3: and His signs and His works which He performed in the midst of Egypt, against Pharaoh king of Egypt and against all the people of his land —
translations.4: and what He did to the army of Egypt and its horsemen and its chariots, over whose faces the waters of the Sea of Qulzum (Red Sea) swept when they pursued you — and God destroyed them, unto this day of ours —
translations.5: and what He did for you in the wilderness, until you came to this place —
translations.6: and what He did to Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab son of Reuben — when the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and their houses and their tents, and all the people who were with them, in the midst of all the sons of Israel.
translations.7: Rather, it is your own eyes that saw all the great work of God which He performed.
translations.8: So keep all the law which I command you today, that you may be strong, and enter and take possession of the land to which you are going to take possession of it.
translations.9: And that your span of time in it may be long — as He swore to your fathers that He would give it to them and to their offspring — it being a land flowing with milk and honey.
translations.10: And know that the land to which you are going to take possession of it is not like the land of Egypt which you left — where you used to sow your seed and water it with your foot, like gardens of vegetables.
translations.11: But the land to which you are crossing over to take possession of it is a land of mountains and valleys; from the rain of the sky it drinks water.
translations.12: It is a land which God your Lord has taken under His care, and His provision for it is constant, from the beginning of the year to its end.
translations.13: If you hearken faithfully to My commandments which I command you today — to love God your Lord and to serve Him sincerely, with all your hearts and all your souls —
translations.14: I shall send down rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the late rain, and you shall gather in your grain and your juice and your oil.
translations.15: And I shall cause grass to grow in your wilderness for your beasts, and you shall eat and be satisfied.
translations.16: But take care lest your hearts be deceived, so that you stray and worship other objects of worship and bow down to them.
translations.17: For then the wrath of God shall intensify against you, and He shall withhold the rain from the sky, and the earth shall not bring forth its yield — and you shall perish swiftly from the good land which God is giving you.
translations.18: And set these words of Mine in your hearts and in your souls; and bind them as a sign upon your hands, and let them be displayed between your eyes.
translations.19: And teach them to your children, and study them in the state of your sitting in your dwelling and your walking on your way, and at your lying down and your rising up.
translations.20: And write them upon the doorposts of the openings of your dwellings and your gates.
translations.21: That your days and the days of your children may be long in the land which God swore to your fathers that He would give them — like the days of the sky over the earth.
translations.22: For if you keep all these commandments which I command you and act by them — loving God your Lord, and walking in all His ways and cleaving to them —
translations.23: then God shall cut away all these nations from before you, and you shall inherit nations more numerous and stronger than yourselves.
translations.24: Every place upon which your foot treads shall be yours — from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river Euphrates and the great sea shall be your border.
translations.25: No one shall stand before you; rather, your terror and your dread shall God your Lord cast upon all the land through which you pass, as He has promised you.
translations.26: See — I am reciting over you today blessings and curses:
translations.27: as for the blessings — if you accept the commandments of God your Lord which I command you today;
translations.28: and as for the curses — if you do not accept the commandments of God your Lord, and you stray from the way which I command you today, and you follow other objects of worship which you have not known.
translations.29: And when God your Lord brings you into the land to which you are going to take possession of it, then recite the blessings upon Mount Gerizim and the curses upon Mount Ebal.
translations.30: Are they not on the western side of the Jordan, behind the road of the setting of the sun, by the land of the Canaanite who dwells in the valley, near Gilgal, by the meadow of Moreh?
translations.31: For you are crossing the Jordan to enter and to take possession of the land which God your Lord is giving you; and when you have taken possession of it and settled in it —
translations.32: keep and act according to all the statutes and the ordinances which I am reciting over you today.
